text:
jonas: FYI — NovaCare is pushing hard for compliance artifacts for the POC. They asked for SOC 2 evidence + a signed pen-test letter before kickoff. They also want a single-tenant private POC. Can we meet that timeline?
amelia: Do they mean the full Type II report or is a SOC2 attestation summary + control matrix acceptable?
jonas: They said "attestation + signed pen-test letter" in the initial email. No explicit ask for the full Type II doc, but sales says legal is nervous and they're using it as a gating item.
sec_julie: We can provide SOC2 attestation summary, control matrix, and network diagram immediately. For a *signed* pen-test attestation, our assessor requires scheduling; standard SLA is ~2-3 weeks. We do offer an expedited path (partner priority) — cost and a required kickoff window.
sara-ops: Operational constraints: private single-tenant POC needs VPC prep + creds rotation + ephemeral IP window. Setup fee is $2,250. Expedited pen-test add-on (partner fee to accelerate delivery) is $6,500 and needs payment + scheduling to hit ~4 business day turnaround. Reserved-month pricing estimate (if they convert) is ~$8,000/month.
amelia: OK. I'll draft a response that buys time: ship the attestation summary + control matrix + network diagram + current external scan. Offer expedited signed pen-test letter as a paid add-on with timeline. Can someone paste the exact artifacts we can ship today so I can include them verbatim?
sec_julie: Artifacts available immediately:
```
- SOC 2 attestation summary (PDF)
- Control matrix (spreadsheet)
- Network architecture diagram (PDF)
- Latest external vulnerability scan export (JSON/CSV)
- Pen-test attestation template (unsigned) — signed copy only with expedited engagement
- KMS key segregation diagram (if needed)
```
jonas: Client asked if we can commit to <14 days for the signed letter in exchange for moving to reserved capacity. Can we consider a contractual commitment tied to an upfront reserved payment?
sec_julie: We can contractually commit to delivery within X days after payment and scheduling confirmation, but we can't guarantee signing before the assessor completes validation. Proposed language: "Signed pen-test attestation to be delivered within 10 business days following receipt of payment and scheduling confirmation."
sara-ops: Note: expedited scheduling is subject to assessor availability. Earliest possible based on current calendar: 4 business days after payment + kickoff. We'll need two blackout windows (maintenance/patch windows) flagged to the customer.
amelia: I'll include that proposed clause and note redaction policy: we redact sensitive customer findings and remove any third-party customer data before sharing. Also include evidence delivery route (secure DLP share or SFTP).
evidence-bot: Created ticket CPL-2241 for NovaCare evidence + POC expedite. Owner: amelia. https://internal/tickets/CPL-2241
jonas: Sounds like a plan. I'll send the proposal with the artifact list, pricing lines (VPC POC $2,250; expedited pen-test $6,500; 1-month reserved $8,000) and the contractual language about delivery windows. CC legal on the email. :thumbsup:
amelia: Thanks — I'll draft now and post the email for review before sending.
